what: Phase 3 completed: Pure-Go Local Vector Engine and Hybrid Search implemented and verified against CI gates
why: Phase 3 of sv-memory enhancements: eliminate keyword mismatch failures via hybrid lexical and dense vector search
learned: Pure-Go local vector engine (subword n-grams, L2 normalization, and cosine similarity) provides resilient hybrid search (match_mode=hybrid) combining BM25 keyword precision with semantic vector recall, with zero external CGO/Python/Docker dependencies.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
